newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Italian ex-porn queen to star in Brazil soap.
newsitem.headline: Italian ex-porn queen to star in Brazil soap.

text.p: Italian former porn queen and member of parliament Cicciolina has been signed to act in a Brazilian soap opera, playing the role of a brothel owner, a television company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Hungarian-born Cicciolina (Cuddles), whose real name is Ilona Staller, is due to arrive in Brazil on June 3 for three days of filming for the soap opera "Xica da Silva" set in 18th century Brazil, the spokeswoman for Manchete television said.
"Cicciolina will play the part of an Italian prostitute from Genoa who pretends to be Princess Ludovica and opens a brothel...," she said.
Xica da Silva tells the story, based on fact, of a slave girl who ends up marrying a representative of the Portuguese crown when Brazil was still a Portuguese colony.
Staller, 45, a member of the Italian parliament from 1987 to 1992, said in a newspaper interview she wanted to bathe naked on the beaches of Rio.

"I would love to go for a swim on Copacabana beach with the people from Rio, naked in the moonlight," O Dia newspaper quoted her as saying in a telephone interview from Rome. "That would be exotic and exciting."
